name: Databases & Data Modeling
description: Relational and NoSQL database management, advanced SQL querying, schema normalization and indexing optimization, transaction management (ACID, isolation levels), ORM usage and N+1 prevention, schema migrations, and high-availability database architectures (replication, sharding, partitioning).

subskills.name: Relational Data Modeling
subskills.description: Schema design, normalization (1NF to 3NF), foreign keys, check constraints, cascade actions, and entity-relationship modeling.

subskills.name: Advanced SQL Querying
subskills.description: Complex joins, aggregations, window functions (ROW_NUMBER, RANK, LAG/LEAD), Common Table Expressions (CTEs), and subqueries.

subskills.name: Indexing & Query Optimization
subskills.description: B-Tree, Hash, and GIN indexes, composite indexes, query execution plans (EXPLAIN ANALYZE), index selectivity, and table scans.

subskills.name: Transactions & ACID
subskills.description: Transaction isolation levels (Read Committed, Repeatable Read, Serializable), dirty reads, non-repeatable reads, phantom reads, and MVCC.

subskills.name: ORMs & Data Mappers
subskills.description: ORM query building (Prisma, TypeORM, Hibernate, SQLAlchemy), N+1 query detection, lazy vs eager loading, and raw SQL fallbacks.

subskills.name: Schema Migrations
subskills.description: Version-controlled database migrations (Flyway, Liquibase, Alembic, Prisma Migrate), zero-downtime column migrations, and rollback strategies.

subskills.name: NoSQL Document & Key-Value Stores
subskills.description: Document modeling in MongoDB, key-value data structures in Redis, DynamoDB partition keys, schema flexibility, and indexing.

subskills.name: Sharding & Table Partitioning
subskills.description: Horizontal table partitioning (range, list, hash), database sharding strategies, shard key selection, and cross-shard queries.

subskills.name: Replication & High Availability
subskills.description: Primary-replica replication (sync vs async), read replicas, failover automation, write-ahead logging (WAL), and split-brain mitigation.

subskills.name: Distributed Transactions & Consistency
subskills.description: Two-Phase Commit (2PC), Saga pattern (orchestration vs choreography), Outbox pattern, Change Data Capture (CDC), and eventual consistency.

ORM development and database migration management

linkedin.signal: Database architecture or High Availability experience

junior.description: Designs normalized relational tables, writes SQL queries with joins and aggregations, uses ORMs, and manages migration files.

mid.description: Analyzes query plans with EXPLAIN ANALYZE, configures transaction isolation levels, and works with NoSQL/document stores.

senior.description: Architects sharded and partitioned datasets, designs replication failover topologies, and implements distributed transaction patterns (Saga/Outbox).
